description: Adds the Google Cloud Storage SDK so Tiger can store media in Google Cloud Storage — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Google Cloud Storage in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the AWS and Azure SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: First-party provider module. Vendors google/cloud-storage (Apache-2.0) as a release-asset bundle; ships no controllers/routes — Bootstrap registers the bundled SDK autoloader, active-only. type:sdk. Mutually exclusive with the AWS / Azure SDK providers via module.json conflict.
